Use case: sketch-to-render. Create one polished photorealistic square REAR architectural image for a house concept PDF.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY reference: a perspective model built from the actual measurements. Preserve its geometry, proportions, camera direction, shallow garden, canopy attachment width, and EVERY window position. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for cream plaster, timber canopy soffit, slim dark posts, terracotta tile, eight-seat outdoor dining, warm lighting and planting. Image 3 supplies measured opening positions. Do not copy Image 2's massing or deeper lawn.
The same Las Juntas house: 9 m wide, lower floor 10.5 m deep, upper 9.5 m deep. Their front faces align, so the UPPER REAR FACADE IS RECESSED 1.0 m behind the LOWER REAR FACADE, clearly expressed by the stepped side edges and narrow lower roof strip in Image 1. Realistic warm late-afternoon architectural photography, straight verticals and detail. If any living furniture is seen through the RIGHT window, seating faces the right SIDE wall with the TV there, not an invented rear TV wall.
Turn the measured model into the warm lived-in material language of Image 2 without changing its measured geometry. Do not reproduce diagram text, labels, borders or numbers. No people, watermarks, logos, pool, deep lawn, extra story or roof terrace.
